items.statement: Debtors increased as of 31st March 2025 due to revenue skew towards last four months and longer collection cycles in opportunity states.
items.quote: As a result, as of 31st March 2025, the debtors were higher versus the previous years.

items.statement: Preferential allotment is underway and expected to close shortly.
items.quote: Yes, yes, that is under way as of now and we would be closing this shortly.

items.statement: Chennai plant loss of INR11-12 crore hit bottom line; INR10 crore trial run losses capitalized per IND-AS
items.quote: We made a loss of around INR11 crores, INR12 crores in Chennai, which has hit the bottom line by around INR11 crores. And I think INR10 crores we have capitalized as trial run losses, we could do that as per the IND-AS accounting standard.

items.statement: Company plans to raise INR500-750 crores fresh capital after shareholder approval on March 2nd; format (QIP, preferential, rights) still under evaluation.
items.quote: Apart from that, we continue with our plans on the equity raise. We are on track, we got the shareholder approval on the 2nd of March and once we come up with the results, we will be on course to raising the INR500 crores to INR750 crores of fresh capital that we had planned.

items.statement: Promoters hold 35% plus 5% management; no further dilution planned and promoter warrants to be subscribed before September will increase holding
items.quote: No, so there are no plans of further dilution. There are. The numbers will only at all points in that. These numbers will remain constant, or they'll go up from here.

items.statement: Promoters will subscribe to share warrants before September increasing their holding
items.quote: Also, one more point Raja. The there are the share warrants which the promoters are going to subscribe. So by, you know, before September, so that is also which will increase the promoters holding.

items.statement: DSO improved over last year despite heavy deal signing in second half; 90% of receivables are less than 180 days
items.quote: Our days is outstanding. We've improved over last year now, despite this year, being a heavy year in terms of. In the second half of the year. We have signed a lot of deals, but our DSO has still improved over the last year, and one more important point here.

items.statement: 90% of receivables are less than 180 days
items.quote: are 90% of our receivables are less than 180 days right payal?

items.statement: Equity-cum-debt raise of USD 13 million nearly complete; equity money received, debt signing in progress to close within 30 days
items.quote: The current raise we are, we are finished. We are doing an equity. Come debt deal. So we are just signing papers right now. So a lot of the equity money has come in the debt. Signing is happening as we speak. so we should complete all of these over the next 30 days.

items.statement: ESOP expense is 3.3 crores out of total employee cost
items.quote: out of the total employee cost the ESOP expenses is 3.3 crores.
